verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party bulk 'export all data' feature in open formats. Carta's read API endpoints for cap tables, stakeholders, option grants and convertible notes, and the investor data warehouse, are developer building blocks a user could script an export from, not a documented export-and-leave capability. Community reports also describe Carta as hard to cancel and hard to transfer a cap table elsewhere, which is consistent with no portability feature being evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
